composition.subject_anchor_priority: one large complete cup-saucer-spoon assembly; narrow off-frame waffle sliver upper-left and small off-frame magazine corner upper-right

environment.background_plane: warm ivory-white matte cafe tabletop inside a minimal white room
environment.surface_character: subtle real matte texture, never seamless
environment.sun_patch_shape: no sun patch; only broad diffuse tonal modulation

lighting.source: one very large upper-left diffuse window
lighting.shadow_description: compact attached contacts plus broad feathered environmental shadows

capture.shadow_processing: retain the spatial separation between elevated tabletop, receding floor and off-frame room volume
capture.local_texture: retain ceramic or source-container construction, beverage identity, ice and toppings without artificial microcontrast

human_rendering.skin_texture: not applicable because no hand is active
human_rendering.light_response: not applicable because no hand is active

material_rules.glass: preserve beverage optics; adopt mode transfers the one-piece low straight cylindrical reference glass, while the approved saucer and spoon remain scene-authoritative. Re-illuminate bright low-chroma milk or cream into the warm-neutral ceramic and table exposure while preserving beverage-internal color relationships; never preserve an isolated source-white point
material_rules.plastic: preserve exact user-cup family in source mode while integrating it with the approved saucer and spoon

coupling_rules: Cup, beverage, saucer, spoon, support and props share one diffuse exposure.
Bright low-chroma milk or cream shares the tabletop and ceramic white balance, reflection, contact shadow and highlight shoulder while its beverage-relative color contrast remains intact.
The approved saucer and wood-handled teaspoon remain present in both modes.
Adopt mode uses the low straight cylindrical reference glass; preserve mode uses the exact user cup.
Peripheral props communicate depth and never become miniature subjects.

hard_fail: light and shadows do not communicate room volume
